messages:
Samira: Foundry onboarding QBR prep — token runway for next 30 days looks tight (~68% projected burn). Can ops / CS confirm spend forecast + who owns enablement? Need action items for tomorrow's QBR.
Jesse: Putting numbers together. We saw a spike after the embed rollout on Tue. @Maya can you share the updated forecast? Also want to flag renewal risk if ramp keeps up.
Maya: On it. Quick check: projected 30d burn ~72% with current cadence (embedding-heavy). I can push an enablement email + best-practices doc today. Suggest we default per-user throttle to 2x and enable prefix caching for repetitive calls. Draft here: https://redwood-internal/notes/foundry-embed-optimize (draft).
Ravi: +1 on throttle. Also proposing a temporary credit-topup offer (one month, trial tier) for early adopters to smooth renewals. Can ops surface estimated $ delta? cc @Ava-Sales for renewals language.
Ava-Sales: Legal gave a greenlight for a constrained credit offer (terms in doc). I can draft a renewal outreach one-liner and coordinate with AM. Need the exact 30d projection number for playbook.
billing-bot: Alert: foundry-account acct_6732 projected 30d burn 72% (>70%) — generating invoice estimate and pushing notification to billing channel.
Samira: Ok — concise action list: (1) Maya: draft enablement email + docs and add best-practice checklist; (2) Jesse: drop spend forecast and burn curve into the QBR deck; (3) Ava-Sales: craft renewal note and send follow-up cadence; (4) Ravi: finalize credit-topup terms and estimated cost. Everyone ack?
Maya: ack :white_check_mark: I’ll post the doc and email copy here in 30m.
Jesse: ack :+1: I'll include a 2-slide appendix showing per-route token breakdown and the projected effect of throttle.
Ava-Sales: ack — will draft the one-liner and include CTA for a 30-min enablement session.
Ravi: working on the credit numbers, will add a simple opt-in flow and rollback plan to the playbook.
Jesse: Throttle snippet to include in ops playbook:
```
# temporary per-user throttle
billing.limit.per_user=2
embed.max_tokens=1024
cache.prefix.enabled=true
```
Samira: Great. I’ll assemble a short slide with the action items and send the QBR deck update by EOD. Keeping thread for tracking — last sync at 1736001299.
